title: 第3731章 直接拿捏第3730章 你不亏直接喜当妈
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
见状。
在场的人瞳孔猛地一缩。
三境中位神，竟被此人一脚踹飞？
不是说，这周一是一境中位神吗？为什么会这么强？
他们刚从试炼之地出来不久，对于苏凡的事迹都是听人说的，所以认知还停留在苏凡前往南疆之前，以为苏凡还是一境中位神。
“小爷好不容易才给那两个可怜的孩子找了个合适的后妈，今天要是被你搅黄了，小爷废了你！”
苏凡大骂一句，看着江采薇：“采薇妹妹，我那两个孩子真的很懂事，不会嫌弃你。”
江采薇一脸难以置信：“你说什么？不会嫌弃我？”
“对呀！”
苏凡点头，很认真地说道：“一般人想当它们的后妈，还没这资格呢，所以能让小爷看上，是你的荣幸。”
趴在姬小月肩上的小青龙点头如捣蒜。
江采薇沉着脸。
“混蛋，你知道江师姐是什么人？知道她是什么实力？居然敢对她大不敬，给我死吧！”
壮汉灰头土脸的冲上来，取出一把黑色战斧，携带着滚滚杀意，朝苏凡劈去。
“你真的……”
苏凡转头盯着壮汉，眼中杀机迸射：“很烦人！”
话音未落，他一个瞬移出现在壮汉身前，侧身躲开战斧的劈杀，拳头神力涌动，一拳轰在壮汉的小腹上。
咔嚓一声！
气海当场破碎。
壮汉一声痛苦的惨嚎，嘴里血喷如注。

他难以置信地看着苏凡：“一拳打破我的气海，这怎么可能？”
苏凡一脸轻蔑：“小爷打破你的气海很奇怪？区区三境中位神，蝼蚁一样的东西，也敢在小爷面前叫，老天爷给你的勇气？”
拳头再次发力。
壮汉一大口鲜血喷出，壮硕的身躯如一枚炮弹，再次轰进那座大山，生死不明。
“三境中位神在他面前毫无还手之力，他到底什么修为？”
一群名人堂弟子震惊万分。
这简直就是一个怪物。
苏凡傲然而立，扫视着在场的所有名人堂弟子：“不服气，你们一起上。”
“什么？”
“居然让我们一起上？”
“该死，从来没见过这么嚣张的狗东西。”
content_en:
See this.
The pupils of the people present shrank suddenly.
The middle god of the three realms was actually kicked away by this person?
Didn't it mean that this Monday was the middle god in the first realm? Why is it so strong?
Not long after they came out of the trial place, they had heard about Su Fan's deeds from others, so their understanding was still before Su Fan went to southern Xinjiang, thinking that Su Fan was still a mid-level god.
"I have finally found a suitable stepmother for those two poor children. If you mess with me today, I will destroy you!"
Su Fan cursed and looked at Jiang Caiwei: "Sister Caiwei, my two children are really sensible and won't dislike you."
Jiang Caiwei looked in disbelief: "What did you say? You won't dislike me?"
"Yes!"
Su Fan nodded and said seriously: "Most people who want to be their stepmothers are not qualified, so it is an honor for you to attract my attention."
Xiao Qinglong, who was lying on Ji Xiaoyue's shoulder, nodded.
Jiang Caiwei's face was solemn.
"Asshole, do you know who Senior Sister Jiang is? Do you know what her strength is? How dare you disrespect her so much, you die!"
The strong man rushed forward in disgrace, took out a black battle ax, and struck Su Fan with murderous intent.
"You really..."
Su Fan turned to stare at the strong man, with murderous intent in his eyes: "Very annoying!"
Before he finished speaking, he teleported and appeared in front of the strong man, ducked sideways to avoid the attack of the tomahawk, and with the divine power of his fist surging, he punched the strong man in the lower abdomen.
Click!
The air sea shattered on the spot.
The strong man howled in pain, and blood spurted out from his mouth.
He looked at Su Fan in disbelief: "Break my Qi sea with one punch, how is this possible?"
Su Fan had a look of contempt on his face: "Is it strange for me to break your Qihai? A mere middle god of the three realms, a thing like an ant, dares to scream in front of me, how dare God give you the courage?"
The fist exerted force again.
The strong man spurted out a mouthful of blood, and his strong body was like a cannonball, blasting into the mountain again, his life and death unknown.
"The middle god of the three realms has no power to fight back in front of him. What kind of cultivation level does he have?"
A group of Hall of Fame disciples were shocked.
This is simply a monster.
Su Fan stood proudly and glanced at all the Hall of Fame disciples present: "If you are not convinced, you all come together."
"What?"
"You actually let us come together?"
"Damn it, I've never seen such an arrogant bitch before."
